name: Lay's Classic Salted Potato Chips (Remission Portion)
whyItWorks: Thinly sliced potatoes fried in vegetable oil and seasoned with salt. They contain minimal fiber (1g), but the moderate fat content (10g per serving) can accelerate transit during active flares.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Best enjoyed during remission in a single 1-oz portion (about 15 chips). Chew thoroughly until completely pulverized before swallowing.
watchOuts: The oil content can stimulate rapid gallbladder emptying and loose stools during active flare-ups.
